purpose: Measure material behavioral-regression frequency without selecting pairs after observing their result.

releaseBoundary.r0Definition: The first independently reviewed external release containing one automatic APM plan-to-exact-materialization-to-contained-check-to-restore path.

sample.orderingAuthority: The proof-ingestion service assigns receivedAt and a monotonically increasing accepted sequence before artifact acquisition, verdict computation, or evidence inspection.

channelAdmission: The channel has an independently reviewed external release.
The pair was proposed for a real external update, not a demo, corpus replay, maintainer test, or CI retry.
The current and candidate identities were exact and immutable before evaluation.
The inclusion or exclusion record was written before artifact inspection or verdict computation.
includeWhen: The event is external and explicitly opted in.
The update has a real intended application by that external entity.
The exact pair is globally unique under the registered deduplication key.
The component has fewer than 20 previously included pairs.
Both identities are immutable and supported by the released adapter.

allRequiredEvidence: Exact current and candidate artifact identities are bound.
The current baseline produces stable passing canary evidence.
Two contained candidate trials produce the same bounded result.
A planted or adjacent negative control behaves as expected.
The evidence is reproducible from retained non-secret commitments.
notMaterialAlone: Expected migration with no workflow or policy consequence.
Flaky, incomplete, unstable, or uncontained evidence.
A version, manifest, or file change without a demonstrated consequence.

interpretation.underSampleFloor: Fewer than 100 eligible pairs is insufficient distribution volume, not a problem-frequency result.
interpretation.gateMiss: Fewer than three reproducible material regressions after 100 eligible pairs rejects or narrows the broad Team subscription thesis.
interpretation.gatePass: Three material regressions passes only the bounded frequency gate; it does not prove demand, willingness to pay, revenue, or retention.
